generation_guards._about: Part 10 (Transformer internals, §10.14) reference-system guards against generation failures. They use vLLM's public sampling parameters; real providers' settings are not public (class D).

repetition_max_pattern_tokens.note: vLLM RepetitionDetectionParams.max_pattern_size: the longest repeated token pattern the engine looks for. 64 tokens covers a repeated sentence or a repeated short list item.

repetition_min_pattern_tokens.note: min_pattern_size: patterns shorter than 8 tokens (for example '| ' table separators or digit runs) repeat legitimately, so they never stop a stream.

repetition_min_count.note: min_count: a pattern must repeat 6 times back to back before the engine stops the sequence with FINISHED_REPETITION. Low enough to stop a loop within a few hundred tokens, high enough to allow a 5-row table with identical rows.

malformed_output_regenerations.note: When the orchestrator rejects a tool call or a JSON answer that fails schema validation, it runs the pass once more with the validation error appended; a second failure returns an error to the client. Separate from the transport retry layer of RA-12.
